findings: Previous default-time-limit and match-all-domain findings have source changes and new focused tests; Linux behavior proof remains pending.
The patch also changes QueryLimits and two dependency lockfiles; these require Linux verification at the source head.

The handler enumerates index fields and uses field-presence queries directly; it contains no Luke request. A detailed Luke request on two live collections received no client response before a 20-second wrapper deadline; server completion and cancellation are unknown.
Timeouts can still return a partial header without the accumulated field listing; this remains a separate design decision.
